title: Investigatory data administrator
description:
BDS Recruitment are looking for 2 temporary administrators on a remote basis with occasional travel to Bradford. The position is working with a local housing association on an initial 3 month basis for a new project.

Hours are 37.5 per week worked Monday to Friday 9am - 5pm

14.35 paye or 18.52 umbrella

The post holder will be responsible for completing a number of repetitive tasks to resolve data issues in the Northgate system with guidance and support from the data resolution manager. This will be extended for you to complete some investigatory data work to help resolve some data issues so a curious mind alongside an eye for detail would be beneficial for this opportunity.

Criteria:

Strong Administrative background preferably within an IT Environment

Strong attention to detail with a passion for data excellence

Experience of compliance, with the ability to operate flexibly across technical, compliance, and governance domains.

Expertise in data quality management, with a strong attention to detail and issue resolution.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and compliance management software

The ability to work self-directed, and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.

Please apply now for immediate consideration.

title: Part-time Administrator
description:
Part-time Rota & Staff Engagement Administrator

£14.36 per hour 25 hours Monday-Friday - these hours may increase Immediate Start Temp-to-Perm Opportunity

This role is all about managing staff rotas and ensuring shifts are covered across SEND programmes. Using Rotacloud, you'll schedule staff, advertise shifts, arrange cover for absences, and help ensure the right staffing levels are in place.

Key duties:
- Create and manage staff rotas
- Fill shifts and arrange sickness/holiday cover
- Liaise with managers on staffing requirements
- Build relationships with staff and answer rota queries
- Keep workforce records up to date
- Produce staffing reports and monitor staffing levels

Ideal background:
- Previous rota, scheduling or workforce planning experience
- Strong organisation and communication skills
- Comfortable using Microsoft Office and online systems
- Able to work under pressure and solve problems quickly

Experience in care, education, childcare, SEND or staffing coordination would be advantageous but is not essential. Full training will be provided.

This is a fantastic temp-to-perm opportunity for someone looking to join a growing organisation and make a real impact within a busy coordination role.

title: Temporary Office Support/Sales Administrator
description:
Temporary Office Support/Sales Administrator

Location: Bradford BD2 (On-site)
Hourly Rate: 13.00 - 14.42 per hour ( 27,000 - 30,000 equivalent salary)
Job Type: Full-time, Temporary with the potential to become permanent for the right candidate
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm (30-minute lunch break, flexibility available)
Parking: Free on-site parking

The Opportunity

Office Angels are working with a company based in Bradford BD2 who are looking to recruit an organised and proactive Office Support & Sales Administrator on a temporary basis.

This is a varied position supporting multiple areas of the business, including sales administration, order processing, customer service, and general office support. This opportunity would suit someone with excellent organisational skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and building positive relationships with customers and colleagues.

Please note that the role is fully office-based whilst temporary. Should the position become permanent, there may be the opportunity for hybrid working.

Key Duties
- Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently.
- Preparing quotations, sales orders, and customer documentation.
- Updating and maintaining customer records, orders and databases.
- Liaising with customers regarding order status and delivery updates.
- Supporting the sales team with administrative tasks and reporting.
- Monitoring order progress and resolving any discrepancies.
- Coordinating with warehouse, purchasing, and logistics teams.
- Ensuring customer orders are fulfilled accurately and on time.
- Providing general administrative support across the business.
- Answering incoming telephone calls and directing enquiries appropriately.
- Managing emails and correspondence.
- Assisting with meeting preparation and office organisation.
- Handling routine customer enquiries and requests.
- Escalating issues where appropriate.

Key Attributes
- Previous experience as a Sales Administrator
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel.
- Experience using SAP is essential
- Ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Next Steps

If you have the experience we are looking and looking for a varied and rewarding opportunity with the potential to secure a permanent position, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your CV today or contact the Office Angels team for further information. Interviews will be arranged as suitable applications are received.
